proof.text: Apply the proved [lem-exc-proetale-finite-supported-module-units] to obtain supported closed units, zero open restriction of closed direct images, and invertibility of the pulled-back open unit. That module proves the individual-module input using the unit-preserving abelian comparison and the existing abelian support theorem.

By [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact], open pullback preserves kernels. Its value on the kernel of an open unit is the kernel of an invertible map and hence zero. The closed supported-unit criterion therefore makes every closed unit on these kernels invertible.

Kernel maps preserve identities, compositions and sums by cancellation of their monic inclusions; the defining kernel lift equation proves naturality. Whisker the closed unit with the kernel functor, obtain a natural isomorphism from its invertible components, and apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex. Whiskering with the full inclusion of epic-unit complexes gives e, with exactly the prescribed closed-unit components.

The kernel condition, degreewise, proves that e inverse followed by the kernel inclusion composes to zero with the open unit. For every degree the open unit is epic by the defining object property. Its kernel short complex is short exact. Transport along the degree component of e and identity comparisons at the other two vertices. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-cochain-complexes-degreewise-exact] to obtain short exactness of complexes, while retaining the degreewise assertion. All arrows are natural transformations by construction.

title: Finite-ring supported units and kernel complexes
statement:
Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]), let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $A$ be a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. Use the coefficient sheaves $A_S$ and left module categories on the small pro-etale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with inverse images and units from [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]. Put $n=\operatorname{ord}_{(A,+)}(1_A)\geq1$ and $B=\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$, with its central map $B\to A$. Assume that, for the commutative coefficient sheaves $B_S$, the essential image of $i_*$ is precisely the sheaves killed by $j^*$ and their closed adjunction units are isomorphisms, as stated in [lem-exc-proetale-closed-essential-image].

Then for every left $A_T$-module sheaf $N$ with $j^*N=0$, the actual $A_T$-linear closed unit $N\to i_*i^*N$ is an isomorphism, naturally in $N$. For every left $A_Z$-module sheaf $M$, one has $j^*i_*M=0$.

For any cochain complex $I$ of left $A_T$-module sheaves such that every termwise open unit $I^q\to j_*j^*I^q$ is epic, let $F^q=\ker(I^q\to j_*j^*I^q)$ in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and put $H(N)=i^*\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$. The differentials of $I$ restrict to these kernels, and the closed units form an isomorphism of complexes $F\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*H(I)$. Composing its inverse with the kernel inclusion gives a natural short exact sequence of complexes
$$0\longrightarrow i_*H(I)\longrightarrow I\longrightarrow j_*j^*I\longrightarrow0,$$
where short exact means short exact in each degree [lem-weil-pbc-cochain-complexes-degreewise-exact].

Coefficient category: def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations explicitly identifies the tensor pullback with the transported action r.m=c^{-1}(r)m and with the 03D3-lifted adjunction, so the commutative closed unit in closed-essential-image for B=Z/n is the helper's eta^B. Step 2's transfer is therefore exact, and in any case invertibility of a unit does not depend on the choice of isomorphic left adjoint. Step 1: Z/n to A is well defined and central, and scalar restriction reflects isomorphisms and detects zero. Step 2: the unit equation gives P(eta^A_i) = iso composed with eta^B_i, and beta and alpha give j^*i_*M=0. The quasi-compact j hypothesis matches. Step 3: j^*eta_j is the identity by the restriction description of open-unit-evaluation (finite commutative B), kernel preservation gives j^*G=0, and Step 2 applies to G. Steps 4-5: the kernel differential, d^2=0, the chain map u and its inverse, the degreewise short exact sequence with epic eta, and naturality are all correct. The helper is true: both ring-map composites agree on constant sections, the underlying maps are identities, and the module units have the abelian unit as underlying map. Tested on identities, the zero ring, the empty scheme and a matrix ring. It is not a restatement of the item, and it does not duplicate ring-sheaf-change-adjunction, cbc-finite-open-exchange-scalars, finite-constant-coefficient-transport or the sfb module-object nodes, all of which assume commutative coefficients. Searches cover three kinds, the blueprint from/via fields are correct, and no SGA is cited. Accepted tool_uses: open-unit-evaluation and proetale-constant-exact. The closed-essential-image entry is on the unit's route (sk-prop-sf-closed-unit) and is harmless. No fixes.
